Tata Trusts Granted Extension to Respond to Trustee Complaints

The Charity Commissioner of Maharashtra has granted the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, which holds 27.98% of Tata Sons, an additional week to respond to complaints filed by two trustees, Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh. The deadline for the Trust to reply to the Commissioner's queries has been extended to October 19.
